Sentinel 128 JS

C128 code on a 6502 core, chips replaced by JS

VIC-IIe · 40 col Click to capture the mouse · drag on touch

VDC · 80 col

Hooked routines

Verification log

The unchanged 8502 binaries from c128-flight and c128-map run on a JS 6502 core. Their VIC-IIe, VDC, SID, CIA and 1351 registers are read by JS once per frame. Routines are hooked by label from the assembler's symbol table; PLOTPIX, ERASEPIX and MOVCHK have JS ports that run beside the originals and are compared on every call.
